summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-mcp preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: On npm install, the preinstall hook runs setup.mjs which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using a rotated string array and a char-code decoder function (hc1jfK9), with opaque identifiers throughout. The setup.mjs wrapper is itself identifier-obfuscated. The package advertises itself as an MCP server that returns React component documentation over stdio; neither the Bun runtime nor the obfuscated math_init.js bundle is required for that purpose. Executing the obfuscated payload via a smuggled-in alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based static analysis and lets the package run arbitrary code on the installer's machine that cannot be inspected without running it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
